name: Norman Lebo
role: Candidate for justice of the peace, Billings County, 1886
bio: Norman Lebo was nominated for justice of the peace on the Billings County and stockmen's tickets in March 1886. He appears in the April 1886 election returns for justice alongside Gregor Lang and J. C. Copeland.
